title: REQ · Phaser effect context renders each lighting effect on the effects layer and destroys it
summary: createPhaserEffectContext draws the four new effects using spec depth and colour
description: Context: effectContext.ts switch handles dust, ambientLight and transition. Desired: render moonlightShaft, lampGlow, doorLight and vignette as Phaser game objects at spec.depth, with a destroy that removes every object it created. Dust keeps using resolveKey(spec.asset), the generated dust sprite.
acceptance_criteria: Given each new effect spec, when createEffect runs with a mocked scene, then a game object is added with setDepth(spec.depth)
Given a vignette handle, when destroy runs, then every band object it created is destroyed
Given a dust spec, when createEffect runs, then particles use the key returned by resolveKey for effect:dust
definition_of_done: All effect types rendered and destroyable
non_functional: Colours parsed from spec hex, no literals
